726570101.text: Honored guest, a moment, if you please. I trust you are the Traveler of whom Miss Kamisato has previously spoken?

726570103.text: Then please forgive my intrusion. I am Madarame Hyakubei, a retainer of the Kamisato Clan.

726570104.text: I have heard tell of your great deeds, and Miss Kamisato thinks extremely highly of you. No doubt you are one of great honor, and worthy of our trust.

726570105.text: I have long since wished for the pleasure of making your acquaintance. Unfortunately, I have been unable to extricate myself from my duties recently.

726570107.text: On the contrary, it is you who are too modest. Even the Yashiro Commissioner Kamisato Ayato himself has mentioned you before. He, too, believes that you are worthy of our trust.

726570110.text: I'll get to the point. Since the Yashiro Commission oversees worship at the shrine, we often have the occasion to hear about people's earnest ambitions.

726570111.text: Miss Kamisato, being as kind and thoughtful as she is, convinced the Yashiro Commissioner to allocate resources to help people realize their ambitions.

726570112.text: After some deliberation, he decided to establish a public commission system as the means of achieving this. I am the one he assigned to organize it.

726570113.text: The remuneration is more than ample, but the problem is that there are too many commissions and not enough people to handle them... If you were willing to lend your assistance, that would be wonderful.

726570114.text: If you are unable to start right away, that's no problem. You can simply find me in a few days' time when your schedule is freer.

726570115.text: I have compiled the details of the commissions that we've received so far, if you wish to take a closer look.

726570109.text: Haha, you are every bit as forthright as the stories claim. Please excuse my habitual meandering.

726570201.text: If you should ever have the time and the desire, we would be most grateful indeed for your help.

726570202.text: If all goes well, you will not only be well compensated but your reputation in Inazuma will be enhanced.

726570203.text: Of course, even one such as yourself cannot become a local legend overnight. As with many things in life, you will need to start from something small and work your way up.

726570204.text: Specifically, this means that as your reputation builds up, the commissions you have access to will grow in complexity. Consider it a gauge of the level of trust that people here place in you.

726570205.text: Please give it some thought. It goes without saying that I'd be thrilled if you were willing to help out.

726570206.text: I will leave you to think it over.
